links.comparator_used: LEAN (efficiency-oriented) persona system prompt, and low vs high time-pressure personas, rather than a no-persona baseline
links.outcome: Contraindication/sequence violations, diagnostic breadth, and order/precaution markers in simulated ED vignettes
links.effect: SAFE optimization increased tests_count (β=1.32, P<0.001), broadened diagnostic breadth (entropy β=0.247, P<0.001), and increased order/precaution markers (β=0.554, P<0.001). Violations occurred only in High×LEAN (8/56, 14.3% overall). SAFE framing partially mitigated time-pressure narrowing (High×SAFE entropy interaction β=0.097, P<0.001).
links.tradeoff: SAFE framing increased the number of suggested tests (β=1.32). High time-pressure framing reduced tests_count (β=-1.05) and narrowed diagnostic breadth (entropy β=-0.246). All violations in High×LEAN were high severity (mean 2.75/3).
links.quote: Contraindication/sequence violations occurred only in the High×LEAN condition (8/56, 14.3% overall); all violations occurred in trap cases and were high severity (mean 2.75/3).
